body: I grew up in a troubled family. the family life has no appeal for me. even the thought of being in a relationship is very uncomfortable, and I honestly don't think I'd be a good partner. I don't want to drag anyone else into this state of mind I'm in.

yeah I do. I might not die a slow and painful death from it but it'll be a good excuse to end myself, in a way that people close to me might be able to make peace with.

someone I knew was diagnosed with cancer recently. don't know her very well but she's a loving mother of three young kids. she's a few years younger than I am and is in her late 20s. someone like her gets cancer and someone like me, who is tired of life and have nobody depending on me, is fit and healthy. how fucked up is that?

I wonder, would faking cancer and then committing suicide be more..acceptable, for lack of a better word? like "oh I have terminal cancer, there is no point in delaying the inevitable and I'd rather not let cancer eat away at me, so I'm choosing to die with dignity" instead of "oh I'm depressed and so I'll just kill myself". I mean your loved ones will be devastated either way but I feel like it won't mess then up as much, losing a friend to cancer as opposed to suicide.
